summary: Defines Python code structure analysis schemas and data models covering classes, functions, modules, symbols, parameters, dependencies, and documentation strings.
responsibilities: Defines schema definitions and analysis models for Python code structures, symbols, modules, files, and project configuration.
Provides data models for representing Python classes, functions, methods, parameters, decorators, variables, type aliases, and docstring sections.
relationships: Python schema models and union types represent code structures including classes, functions, methods, callables, variables, imports, dependencies, and docstrings.
design_decisions: Defines schema models and union types for Python code elements, classes, functions, modules, and source structure analyses.
